content: Yazdī collection item 7, to Khwāja Afżal al-Dīn Muḥammad Turka, Ibn Turka's nephew or cousin (ca. 835/1432?): a business letter on tax collection, probably soon after Ibn Turka's death. Yazdī says Ibn Turka's son Khwāja Najīb al-Dīn Ḥabīb Allāh Turka left for Herat after a money dispute with his brothers, that Yazdī intervened, lodged Ḥabīb Allāh at his own house and reallocated the money. MK infers from this letter that Ibn Turka had three sons and seven daughters (YMN/V ff. 167b-68b).
